advice_at_risk: Usual activities. Very sensitive patients can still get symptoms, so follow their asthma or COPD management plan.
Adapt strenuous outdoor activity, especially if symptoms worsen. Follow the management plan and see the GP or nurse if symptoms are new, worse, or not improving after a week.
Reduce exposure to polluted air and adapt strenuous outdoor activity, especially with symptoms. Also applies to older people. Follow the management plan; seek advice if symptoms are new or worse.
